sections.title: Navigate the right panel
sections.excerpt: Navigate the right panel | The right panel is a set of collapsible sections in screen-type order. Expand each accordion to reach its controls; text, styles, translations, and behavior are grouped within their section.

sections.title: Work in the recommended order
sections.excerpt: Work in the recommended order | Configure top to bottom: Header, Content, Options or Media, Action Bar, Background, then Basic Config. This order follows the visitor flow from orientation to visual treatment.

sections.title: Understand shared vs unique sections
sections.excerpt: Understand shared vs unique sections | Shared sections (Header, Action Bar, Backdrop, Basic Config) repeat across screen types; unique sections like Media, Options, or Text Field appear only where the type needs them. Know which sections your screen exposes.

sections.title: Bind variables on selection screens
sections.excerpt: Bind variables on selection screens | Selection screens (list, grid, text input, wheel picker) expose a Variable Binding section. Create or pick a flow variable, map items to options, and set score effects to influence later routing.
